<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.NetNumbering: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Numbers the links of the river network and extracts the sub-basin draining into each link. With a desired area, the links are aggregated into sub-basins of about that size, which can be used as hydrological response units.

**Toolbox folder:** Network<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Network, Sub-basins, Topology, Hydrological response units<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.NetNumbering`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |
| `inTca` | raster file |  |  | The map of total contributing area. |
| `inNet` | raster file |  |  | The map of the network. |
| `inPoints` | vector file |  |  | The monitoringpoints vector map. |
| `pDesiredArea` | Double | m² |  | The desired area of the sub-basins, in squared map units. |
| `pDesiredAreaDelta` | Double | % |  | The allowed deviation from the desired area. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outNetnum` | output file |  | The map of the numbered network links. |
| `outBasins` | output file |  | The map of the sub-basins of each link. |
| `outDesiredBasins` | output file |  | The map of the sub-basins aggregated to the desired size. |
| `outMindmap` | output file |  | Output mindmap (plantuml). |
| `outDesiredMindmap` | output file |  | Output desired mindmap (plantuml). |
| `outGeoframeTopology` | output file |  | The optional geoframe topology output file. |
| `outBasinsInfo` | output file |  | The optional basins info output file. |
